feedback: Fail-closed requirements are not met. clean_builder_generated_artifacts assumes every linked worktree (.git file) is disposable and can delete arbitrary user files merely because they end in .db or .cache; is_disposable_worktree defaults true and factory ownership is not verified. The .gemini/.agy cleanup also mishandles allowed-name directories and may leak raw OSError. AgyBuilder.preflight calls .get() on json.loads output without first verifying it is a dict, so list/null JSON can cause uncaught exceptions; accepting raw non-JSON output also contradicts the requested JSON contract. The CLI arguments are present and run() validates dict/status, while AiderBuilder and clean_aider_generated_artifacts aliases exist, but compatibility is incomplete because exported Aider model defaults changed semantics. Tests do not cover these security cases, write builder_test.log into the current directory, and the committed __pycache__ binary is inappropriate; the supplied diff alone does not demonstrate that the full suite passes.
